transcript.text: Good morning everyone. We need to freeze the campaign sequence for Order K and Order L on Laser Cell 5 before the next shift begins. As you know, we've got 320 aluminum brackets for Order K and 180 stainless enclosures for Order L, both already released for production. Before I sign the final production plan, I need to hear from quality, maintenance, and logistics. Let's start with quality — do we have any known customer constraints or quality concerns on either of these orders?

transcript.text: Elena, I need to flag a customer quality constraint on Order L. The customer control plan requires dimensional scanning of exactly the first 30 stainless enclosures before the remaining units can be released. I confirmed this in the current customer quality file, but the requirement has not yet been added to the internal routing. This means we need to plan for that inspection step on the first 30 stainless enclosures before the rest of Order L can proceed.
transcript.speaker: A2

transcript.text: I need to flag an equipment constraint on Laser Cell 5. My maintenance check found that the assist-gas regulator is outside its stable range for the stainless-steel thickness used by Order L. Replacing it before the stainless run will take exactly 2 hours, but I haven't opened the maintenance work order yet. We need to account for that 2-hour regulator replacement before we start Order L.
transcript.speaker: A3
